svg.title: One K step of the 24 by 8 correlation microkernel
svg.desc: The microkernel loads 24 A values into three eight-double zmm vectors and reads eight B scalars. The highlighted example multiplies one A vector by a broadcast B scalar and adds the old sum, updating one eight-value accumulator register. Repeating this for three A vectors and eight B scalars updates the 24 registers of the 24 by 8 output tile. Eight of the CPU's 32 vector registers remain for operands and temporary values.
svg.text: one K step of the 24 × 8 microkernel
each box = one zmm holding 8 output values
8 of 32 zmm registers remain for operands
